lines.text: All stations, break, break! Strategic weapon away! Flashback is in the air. Turn away from the target. Get below cover. Do not look at the flash!
Flash! Flash! Nuclear detonation! All aircraft, turn away! The shock front is coming. Get down, get down!
Everything is on fire! Get those people inside! Away from the windows! Oh God, the trees are gone! Command, do you read?
Skywatch, this is Dagger! I've lost the whole flight! There's nothing on the scope! Somebody answer me!
We can't see the sun. The roof is coming down! Get back! Command, please, we're still here! We are still...
